text: Meeting deadlines is a crucial skill in both school and work. Effective time management starts with breaking a large project into smaller, manageable tasks and scheduling each one. Prioritization is also key; identify the most critical tasks and tackle those first, rather than spending hours on minor details. Another important aspect is scope management, which means understanding exactly what a task requires and avoiding "scope creep"—adding extra, unrequested features or work. Finally, clear communication is essential. If you foresee a problem, tell your supervisor or teacher early. It is much better to ask for an extension or help in advance than to miss a deadline and deliver nothing.
